name: bees55
text: How do bees make honey? A bee sips nectar from a flower and stores it in a second stomach. Back at the hive, she passes it mouth to mouth to other bees, and their enzymes break down the sugar. They drop it into wax cells and fan it with their wings until most of the water is gone. Then they seal it with wax. One bee makes just a twelfth of a teaspoon in her whole life.
